Definition
[Notation: $U_\epsilon $] 1. appC:C.4-def-1\group Mollification For open $U\subset \mathbb R^n$ and $\epsilon >0$, set \[ U_\epsilon :=\{ x\in U\mid \dist (x,\partial U)>\epsilon \} . \]
